records.explanation: 桓文 refers collectively to Duke Huan of Qi (齊桓公) and Duke Wen of Jin (晉文公), the two famous hegemon-rulers of the Spring and Autumn period. In the main text, 温嶠 says '明公以桓文之姿建匡立之功' (My lord, with the bearing of Huan and Wen, establishes the achievement of rectifying and supporting). This is a comparison: the speaker likens 明公 (Liu Kun) to the exemplary hegemons Huan and Wen. The mention is a collective descriptive reference to two historical figures, not to any person present in the scene. It is distinct from 明公 (the addressee, Liu Kun) since it refers to historical exemplars being compared to him, not to him himself.
records.referent_role: collective reference to Duke Huan of Qi and Duke Wen of Jin, used as exemplars of hegemon-rulers

records.explanation: 文淵 is the courtesy name of 馬援, as stated in the annotation '馬援字文淵'. It corefers with the full name mention 馬援 (sfh1-mention-4182738effab977af190f47f).

records.explanation: 管張 is a collective descriptive reference to 管仲 (Guan Zhong) and 張良 (Zhang Liang), historical exemplars of ministerial talent. 嶠 says he lacks their abilities (雖乏管張之才), comparing himself unfavorably to them, while 明公 (琨) has the ambition of 桓文.

records.explanation: 公孫述 is a full name reference to Gongsun Shu, a warlord contemporary with Ban Biao. He is distinct from 隗囂 (another warlord) and from 光武 (Emperor Guangwu). The annotation states Ban Biao '從公孫述隗囂游' (associated with Gongsun Shu and Wei Xiao).
records.referent_role: 公孫述 (Gongsun Shu), a warlord of the Xin/Han transition period

records.explanation: 温嶠 is the full name of Wen Jiao, the person being addressed by Liu Kun. He is the addressee of the speech and the one asked to go to Jiangnan. He is distinct from Liu Kun and from the historical figures mentioned.

records.explanation: 明公 is an honorific used by 嶠 (Wen Jiao) to address 劉琨 (Liu Kun). It refers to Liu Kun, the person being addressed. The annotation text '明公有桓文之志' shows the honorific refers to Liu Kun who is said to have the ambition of Huan and Wen.

records.explanation: 隗囂 is a full name referring to the warlord 隗囂. It appears in the annotation about 班彪 (彪). The same person 隗囂 appears again in annotation-005 as sfh1-mention-ca846ff5429d84ed38312e0f. 隗囂 is distinct from 彪.

records.explanation: 隗囂 in annotation-005 is the same person as 隗囂 in annotation-004 (both refer to Wei Xiao, the warlord). He is distinct from 公孫述 and 光武. The annotation describes Ban Biao associating with both Gongsun Shu and Wei Xiao.

records.explanation: 桓文 refers to 齊桓公 (Duke Huan of Qi) and 晉文公 (Duke Wen of Jin), two historical hegemon rulers used as exemplars. It is a collective descriptive reference comparing Liu Kun's ambition to these historical figures. This is distinct from Liu Kun himself.

records.explanation: 越石 is the courtesy name (字) of 劉琨, as stated in the annotation '琨字越石'. It corefers with 琨 and the full name 劉琨.

records.explanation: 温公 is an honorific reference to Wen Qiao (温嶠), the same person as 温嶠 (sfh1-mention-f9c56eefb0e8ad55a8376127) and 温 (sfh1-mention-1063e06e0e519c537de6e1c6). He is distinct from the guests and from 王丞相.

records.explanation: 晉王 is a ruler title referring to the Jin prince (Sima Rui, later Emperor Yuan of Jin). It appears in the Liu annotation context about 温奉使勸進晉王. It is distinct from 管仲夷吾 and 齊桓公 who are historical figures from the Spring and Autumn period.
records.referent_role: ruler

records.explanation: 晉王君臣 is a collective reference to the Jin prince and his ministers/officials. It includes 晉王 as part of the group. It is distinct from 賓客 (guests) who are a separate group in the annotation context.
records.referent_role: collective of ruler and ministers

records.explanation: 管仲 is the abbreviated form of Guan Zhong's name, coreferent with 管仲夷吾 (sfh1-mention-d4a5257679415bd6e151d3d8) and 管夷吾 (sfh1-mention-fb00951dabdf8f1a9850fb8c). In the annotation, 温公 is compared to 管仲 (seeing 温公 is like seeing 管仲).
records.referent_role: Guan Zhong

records.explanation: 劉琨 is the person for whom 温嶠 serves as envoy; distinct from 温嶠 and the Chancellor.
records.referent_role: 劉琨 (Liu Kun)

records.explanation: 賓客 refers to the assembled guests who saw 温公 (Wen Qiao) enter. They are a collective group distinct from 晉王君臣 and from 温公 himself.
records.referent_role: guests/visitors

records.explanation: 管仲夷吾 is the full name of Guan Zhong (管仲), styled Yiwu (夷吾). He is the same person as 管仲 (sfh1-mention-8cd8ab54007459d3147314c6) and 管夷吾 (sfh1-mention-fb00951dabdf8f1a9850fb8c). He served as minister to Duke Huan of Qi (齊桓公). 潁上人 describes his origin, not a distinct person.
records.referent_role: historical figure

records.explanation: 齊桓公 is Duke Huan of Qi, the ruler whom Guan Zhong served as minister. He is distinct from Guan Zhong and from 晉王.
records.referent_role: ruler

records.explanation: 丞相 is the abbreviated office title referring to the same person as 王丞相 earlier in the text, i.e., Wang Dao.

records.explanation: 温嶠 is the protagonist, full name form. He is the envoy of 劉琨 and visits 王丞相.
records.referent_role: 温嶠 (Wen Qiao)

records.explanation: 管夷吾 is the full name of Guan Zhong (管仲), the famous Spring and Autumn period minister. In the main text, 温嶠 says '江左自有管夷吾' (the Jiangzuo region naturally has its own Guan Yiwu), referring to 王丞相 (Wang Dao) as a modern-day equivalent of Guan Zhong. The mention 管夷吾 in the main text corefers with 管仲夷吾 and 管仲 in the Liu annotations. It is distinct from all contemporary figures in the story. The comparison relation is between 温嶠's implied referent (王丞相) and 管夷吾, though the surface comparison is made by 温嶠's speech.
records.referent_role: historical figure referenced as exemplar (Guan Zhong / Guan Yiwu)

records.explanation: 王丞相 in the main text refers to Wang Dao, the Chancellor, same person as 丞相 later in the text and 王丞相 in the Liu annotation.
records.referent_role: office holder (王丞相 = Wang Dao)

records.explanation: 劉隗 is a full name reference to Liu Wei. He is distinct from 王導 and 敦 (王敦). The annotation states 敦以劉隗為間 (Dun used Liu Wei as a wedge). 劉隗 in annotation-005 corefers with this mention.
records.referent_role: person being discussed

records.explanation: The personal name 含 in '王敦兄含' refers to Wang Han (王含), the elder brother of Wang Dun. It is the same person as the kinship reference 兄含. The kinship relation to 王敦 is established by the preceding 兄 in the same clause.
records.referent_role: 王含 (Wang Han), elder brother of Wang Dun

records.explanation: 劉隗 is the full name of Liu Wei, coreferring with the earlier mention sfh1-mention-02ba493b066ce3ad38cd1114 in annotation-004. He is the target of the military campaign (討) by Wang Dun (敦/從兄敦) and Wang Dao (導).
records.referent_role: person being referred to (Liu Wei)

records.explanation: 明公 is an honorific used in the letter to address the 丞相/司徒 who went to the palace to apologize (王丞相詣闕謝). The letter writer (顧司空/揚州别駕) addresses this high official as 明公. This is distinct from 王光禄 (王含) and from the letter writer himself.
records.referent_role: honorific address to the 丞相/司徒 (the high official who went to the palace to apologize), likely 王導

records.explanation: 導 is the abbreviated personal name for 王導 (Wang Dao), coreferring with the full name mention sfh1-mention-7f82dcecdf9c9f587fa8ce40. In the annotation, 導 is the subject who leads (率) the 子弟二十餘人 to apologize, and 從兄敦 refers to his elder cousin 敦 (Wang Dun).

records.referent_role: elder paternal cousin (從兄) of 導

records.explanation: 王導 is a full name reference to Wang Dao. He is distinct from 敦 (Wang Dun) and 劉隗 (Liu Wei). The annotation states 導從兄敦 (Wang Dao's elder cousin Wang Dun), establishing a kinship/social relation. 導 in annotation-005 corefers with 王導.

records.explanation: 敦 in annotation-004 is an abbreviated reference to 王敦 (Wang Dun), coreferring with the full name 王敦 in the main text and with 敦 in annotation-002. He is distinct from 王導 and 劉隗. The annotation states 敦以劉隗為間 (Dun used Liu Wei as a wedge/divider).

子弟二十餘人 is a descriptive collective reference to over twenty younger family members (sons and younger brothers). The context 導率子弟二十餘人 indicates these are Wang Dao's (導's) sons and younger brothers, making 導 the patron/possessor. They are distinct from the named individuals 王導, 敦, and 劉隗.

records.explanation: 尊體 is an honorific reference to the body/health of 明公 (the ruler). It is anchored to and corefers with 明公 (sfh1-mention-1091da9b673cc8168e56765b), as it is a respectful way of referring to the ruler's person. It is distinct from 羣下 (the subordinates).

records.explanation: The phrase 兄含 in '王敦兄含' means 'Wang Dun's elder brother Han'. The kinship term 兄 (elder brother) links 含 to 王敦. The mention 含 refers to Wang Han (王含), who is the elder brother of Wang Dun. This is a compositional kinship reference where the kinship term 兄 modifies the personal name 含, anchored to 王敦.
records.referent_role: 王含 (Wang Han), elder brother of 王敦 (Wang Dun)

records.explanation: The office title 丞相 (Chancellor) in '王丞相詣闕謝' refers to Wang Dao (王導), who held the office of Chancellor. records.referent_role: person surnamed 王 holding the office of 光禄 (光禄勲), referring to 王含

records.explanation: 含 in the Liu annotation is the personal name of Wang Han (王含), brother of Wang Dun. The annotation text '與弟/含别傳曰含字處弘琅邪臨沂' identifies 含 as the younger brother (弟) of the person mentioned (王敦). Corefers with 含 in main text and with the kinship reference 兄含. Distinct from 敦/王敦.

records.explanation: This is 甘羅 (Gan Luo) in the Liu annotation, described as the grandson (孫) of 秦相茂. Corefers with other 甘羅 mentions in the story.

records.explanation: 甘羅 (Gan Luo) is a full-name reference to the historical figure Gan Luo, the young Qin minister. Zhi Zhan compares himself to Gan Luo in the main text: '比之甘羅已為太老'. This mention corefers with the other 甘羅 mentions in the Liu annotation (sfh1-mention-08ebf299e3298fb4dd5c9056 and sfh1-mention-18c2a0195cf9afed42144f54). records.explanation: 太常虞 refers to Yu (虞) who held the office of 太常. The annotation says 瞻 is 太常虞's 兄子 (nephew, specifically brother's son). 太常 is the office title, 虞 is the personal name. This person is distinct from 瞻 and from 瞻's father 育.

records.explanation: 孫 here is the kinship term 'grandson' in the phrase '甘羅秦相茂之孫也' (Gan Luo is the grandson of Qin chancellor Mao). It refers to Gan Luo himself, anchored to 秦相茂 as the grandfather. Corefers with the 甘羅 mentions.

records.explanation: 摯瞻 is the full name of the protagonist, appearing at the start of the main text. He is the subject who served as 四郡太守 and 大將軍户曹叅軍. He is distinct from 王敦 and from 將軍 (which refers to 王敦's title).

records.explanation: This is 敦 (Wang Dun) in the Liu annotation. The context '荅敦後知敦有異志' refers to 瞻 answering 敦, then 敦 having rebellious intentions. It corefers with other 敦/王敦 mentions in the story.

records.explanation: 瞻 in annotation-004 refers to 摯瞻 (Zhi Zhan). The text 敦反乃左遷隨郡内史 indicates Wang Dun rebelled and demoted Zhan. This is a local anaphoric reference to Zhi Zhan, distinct from Wang Dun.

records.explanation: 父育 refers to 瞻's father named 育. The kinship term 父 explicitly marks the father-son relationship. The father 育 is distinct from 瞻 and from 太常虞.
records.referent_role: father of 瞻 (Zhi Zhan)

records.explanation: 瞻 is the personal name of 摯瞻 (Zhi Zhan), the main subject. The annotation states 瞻字景游京兆長安人太常虞兄子也, meaning 瞻 is the nephew (兄子) of 太常虞. This mention is coreferential with other instances of 瞻 and 摯瞻 throughout the text.
records.referent_role: Zhi Zhan (摯瞻), the subject of the biography

records.explanation: 唐 is the single-character abbreviated form of 張唐, referring to the same person. It appears in the phrase 唐不肻行 (Tang refused to go), continuing the narrative about Zhang Tang.

records.referent_role: nephew (brother's son) of 太常虞, i.e., 瞻

records.explanation: 敦 refers to 王敦 (Wang Dun). In annotation-004, 敦反乃左遷隨郡内史 — Wang Dun rebelled and demoted 瞻 to Suijun neishi. This is a local anaphoric reference to Wang Dun, distinct from 瞻.

records.explanation: 瞻 in annotation-002 refers to 摯瞻, the subject. He served as 户曹叅軍 under 王敦 (office relation), and '見敦' indicates he met/visited 王敦 (social relation). Distinct from 王敦.
records.referent_role: 摯瞻 (Zhi Zhan), the subject of the biography

records.explanation: 張唐 is the full-name reference to Zhang Tang, the Qin general whom Lü Buwei wanted to send to Yan. The single-character 唐 (sfh1-mention-650014e417b4bf414425276e) is the abbreviated form of the same person, so they corefer.

records.explanation: 王長史 refers to 王濛 (Wang Meng), who held the office of 長史. The annotation sfh1-ev-04-wenxue-022-liu-annotation-004 mentions 王濛王述並為王導所辟, confirming 王濛 as one of the two Wangs. The '兩王掾' later in the text refers to 王濛 and 王述 together. 王長史 is distinct from 桓公 and 王藍田.

records.explanation: 彼我 is a reciprocal pronoun pair referring to the two parties in the dialogue — 殷 (殷中軍) and 丞相 (王導). The phrase '旣彼我相盡' means 'when the two sides had fully exhausted each other's positions,' referring to the mutual exchange between the two main interlocutors.
records.referent_role: collective reference to the two interlocutors (殷 and 丞相) engaged in mutual exchange

records.explanation: The second 丞相 in the text (王丞相為之集...丞相自起解帳) refers to the same person as 王丞相, i.e., 王導. It is an office title used anaphorically to refer back to 王丞相 mentioned earlier in the same sentence.
records.referent_role: 王導, holder of the office of 丞相

records.explanation: No valid semantic record was returned; fail closed.

王述 is the full name of the person whose biography is being annotated. It corefers with 述 (personal name), 懷祖 (courtesy name), and the other 述 mentions. It is distinct from his grandfather 湛 and father 承. The 藍田侯 title is held by 王述 through inheritance (襲爵).
records.referent_role: person being described in biography annotation

records.explanation: 我 in 彼我 is the first-person pronoun within the reciprocal pair, referring to the speaker's side. Given the context of the mutual exchange between 殷 and 丞相, 我 refers to 丞相 (王導), the speaker's perspective in the narrative. The 彼 (other) would be 殷.
records.referent_role: first-person pronoun referring to the speaker (丞相/王導) in the reciprocal exchange

records.explanation: 其母 refers to the mother of 浮圗 (the subject of the preceding passage). The text says '其母夢白象而孕及生從右脅出' — his mother dreamed of a white elephant and became pregnant, and he was born from her right side. This mother is 莫邪, mentioned earlier in annotation 006 as '母曰莫邪'. The mother is distinct from her son 浮圗 and from the king (her husband).
records.referent_role: the mother of 浮圗 (the Buddha)

records.explanation: 浮圗 is the son born to the king of 臨兒國. The text says '其國王生浮圗 浮圗者太子也' — 浮圗 is the crown prince. This 浮圗 is the same person as 浮屠 (the Buddha) mentioned earlier in the same annotation.
records.referent_role: 浮圗, the son of the king of 臨兒國 (i.e., the Buddha)

羣臣 refers to the group of ministers whom 漢明帝 consulted (博問羣臣). It is a collective reference distinct from the emperor and from 傅毅 who is one of the respondents. 通人 (b368416924) appears in the same clause as part of the description of who was consulted, but 羣臣 and 通人 are separate mentions in the same context.
records.referent_role: the assembled ministers/ministers of the court

屑頭邪 is the father of the crown prince (浮圗). The text '浮圗者太子也父曰屑頭邪母曰莫邪' identifies 屑頭邪 as the father and 莫邪 as the mother of the crown prince.
records.referent_role: 屑頭邪, father of the crown prince (浮圗)

records.referent_role: ruler of the kingdom (臨兒國) where 浮圗 was born

records.explanation: 大月氏王 is the ruler of the Great Yuezhi. 伊存 is described as his envoy (使). The king himself is not the direct speaker; rather his envoy 伊存 transmits the scripture.
records.referent_role: King of the Great Yuezhi (大月氏王)

莫邪 is the mother of the crown prince (浮圗). The text '浮圗者太子也父曰屑頭邪母曰莫邪' identifies 莫邪 as the mother of the crown prince.
records.referent_role: 莫邪, mother of the crown prince (浮圗)

伊存 is the envoy (使) of the Great Yuezhi king (大月氏王). He orally transmitted the Buddhist scripture (口傳浮屠經) to 景慮, the 博士弟子. The relation between 伊存 and 大月氏王 is that of envoy to ruler (patron).
records.referent_role: Envoy (使) of the Great Yuezhi king who orally transmitted the Buddhist scripture

神人 refers to the divine being (Buddha) described in the dream of 漢明帝. The text says 漢明帝 dreamed of a 神人 with light on body and able to fly, and 傅毅 responds that this is 佛 (Buddha). So 神人 corefers with 佛 (mention 285bb2df). It is distinct from 漢明帝 (the dreamer) and 傅毅 (the speaker).
records.referent_role: the divine being (Buddha) described as having light on body, able to fly

通人 refers to learned/erudite persons whom 漢明帝 consulted. It is a collective reference distinct from the emperor. It appears alongside 羣臣 in the same clause (博問羣臣通人), describing the group consulted. 傅毅 is one of the respondents but 通人 as a collective is distinct from the individual 傅毅.
records.referent_role: learned/erudite persons consulted by the emperor

records.explanation: 傅毅 is a full name reference. He responds (對曰) to 漢明帝, saying he has heard of a Buddhist figure in India. He is distinct from the emperor.
records.referent_role: speaker/respondent to Han Mingdi

records.explanation: 王遵 is a full personal name, one of the twelve people (十二人) sent to the Yuezhi kingdom to obtain Buddhist scriptures. He is part of the group of twelve, so he is co-present with the collective 十二人 but distinct from the group as a whole and from 秦景 who is separately named in the same passage.
records.referent_role: Wang Zun, one of the twelve people sent to the Yuezhi kingdom

成 is an abbreviated form of 漢成 (Emperor Cheng of Han), referring to the same ruler as the 漢成 mention in annotation-005. It appears in the phrase 哀成之世, paired with 哀 (Emperor Ai), indicating two distinct rulers.
records.referent_role: ruler

records.explanation: 沙律 is mentioned as '天竺又有神人曰沙律' — another divine person in 天竺, distinct from 浮圗/浮屠. The text introduces 沙律 as a separate entity ('又有' = 'additionally there is').
records.referent_role: 沙律, a divine person (神人) in 天竺

漢明帝 is a ruler title referring to Emperor Ming of Han. He dreams of a divine person and asks his ministers broadly (博問羣臣通人), to which 傅毅 responds. He is distinct from Fu Yi and the Buddha.
records.referent_role: Han emperor (Mingdi)

records.explanation: 哀 is an abbreviated form of 哀帝 (Emperor Ai of Han), referring to the same ruler as the full 哀帝 mention in annotation-008. It appears in the phrase 哀成之世 (the era of Ai and Cheng), paired with 成 (Emperor Cheng), indicating two distinct rulers.
records.referent_role: ruler

七十四人 is a subset of the 百四十六人 total, referring to those already found in Buddhist scriptures. It is distinct from the full group of 146.
records.referent_role: subset of the 146 immortals already recorded in Buddhist scriptures

records.explanation: 殷中軍 refers to Yin Zhongjun (殷浩), who held the office of 中軍 (Commander of the Central Army). This is an office-holder reference using the office title to refer to the person. The main text reads 殷中軍見佛經云理亦應阿堵上, where 殷中軍 is the subject who sees the Buddhist scripture.
records.referent_role: office_holder

records.explanation: 漢成 refers to Emperor Cheng of Han (漢成帝). It appears in the phrase 漢成哀之 referring to the reigns of Emperors Cheng and Ai. The mention 成 in annotation-011 (sfh1-mention-c2e6f021db67ced373b8ef0f) refers to the same emperor. It is distinct from 哀 (Emperor Ai).
records.referent_role: Emperor Cheng of Han (漢成帝)

records.explanation: 牟子 is a personal name reference (abbreviated form) referring to the author of the 牟子傳記 (Mouzi's biography/record) mentioned in the annotation. The text references 牟子傳記 as a source compared with other accounts of Buddhism's introduction to China.
records.referent_role: author of a Buddhist-related text/record

records.explanation: 休屠王 is the king of Xiutu. The text '殺休屠王以其衆來降' indicates that someone killed the Xiutu king and his people (其衆) surrendered. The king is distinct from his people (其衆).
records.referent_role: King of Xiutu (休屠王), a ruler whose people surrendered

records.explanation: No valid semantic record was returned; fail closed.
孫龍 (Gongsun Long) is a full name in the Liu annotation, cited as the author of the 'White Horse' argument. He is distinct from 趙人公 who is mentioned in the same annotation as a person from Zhao.
records.referent_role: person mentioned in annotation (Gongsun Long)

records.explanation: 裕 is a single-character personal name appearing in the Zhongxing shu citation within the Liu annotation. The full identity is unclear from the available text; it appears to be an abbreviated reference to a person whose full name is not given in the surviving text.
records.referent_role: person named 裕 in Zhongxing shu annotation

records.explanation: 阮 is the surname-only reference to Ruan Guanglu, coreferring with the office title 阮光禄. It appears in 阮語重相咨盡 where Ruan speaks again and thoroughly consults.
records.referent_role: Ruan Guanglu (surname reference)

records.explanation: 趙人公 is a descriptive reference to a person from Zhao mentioned in the Kongcongzi citation within the annotation. Distinct from 孫龍.
records.referent_role: person from Zhao mentioned in annotation

records.explanation: 謝安 is the full name of Xie An, the young protagonist who invites Ruan Guanglu to discuss the White Horse theory. He corefers with the surname-only 謝 mention. He is distinct from 阮光禄.
records.referent_role: Xie An, the main protagonist

records.explanation: 謝 is the surname-only reference to Xie An, coreferring with the full name 謝安. It appears in the phrase 謝不即解 where Xie does not immediately understand.
records.referent_role: Xie An (surname reference)

records.explanation: 阮光禄 is an office title reference to Ruan Guanglu (Ruan Yu), who holds the Guanglu office. He corefers with the surname-only 阮. He is distinct from Xie An. He is the one invited by Xie An to explain the White Horse theory, and he sighs in admiration at the end.
records.referent_role: Ruan Guanglu (Ruan Yu, holder of Guanglu office)

records.explanation: 弘道法師 is an office/title reference in the annotation. The annotation (sfh1-ev-04-wenxue-030-liu-annotation-002) describes someone as 弘道法師也, indicating this is a title/office held by a person. Without more context in the annotation, the specific identity is uncertain, though it may refer to the same monk discussed in the passage.
records.referent_role: person holding the office/title of 弘道法師

records.explanation: 北來道人 is a descriptive reference to a monk who came from the north. It corefers with 此道人 later in the text. This person is distinct from 林公, 竺法深, and 孫興公 who are other participants in the same scene.
records.referent_role: a monk who came from the north

records.explanation: 法深 is an abbreviated reference to 竺法深 (the monk), appearing in Liu Xiaobiao's annotation. It corefers with the full name 竺法深 in the main text and with 深公 honorific. It is distinct from 庾法暢 who is a different person mentioned in the same annotation.
records.referent_role: person referred to in annotation

records.explanation: 深公 is an honorific reference to 竺法深 (Zhu Fashen), the monk. It corefers with the full name mention sfh1-mention-84f89a725435466970862cbf and the annotation mention sfh1-mention-34d2827a551afd59940eb10d. Sun Xinggong (孫) asks him a question, and he responds to Lin Gong.
records.referent_role: Zhu Fashen (竺法深), the monk addressed by Sun Xinggong

竺法深 is the full name of the monk also referred to as 深公 (honorific) and 法深 (in Liu annotation). He is distinct from 林公, 孫興公, and the 北來道人. He is co-present with them at 瓦官寺.
records.referent_role: 竺法深 (a Buddhist monk, also called 深公)

庾法暢 is a full name of a person mentioned in the annotation, distinct from 法深. The annotation cites 庾法暢's 人物論 as a source about 法深's learning.
records.referent_role: person mentioned in annotation

records.explanation: 孫興公 is the full name of the person also referred to by the surname 孫. He is distinct from 林公, 竺法深, and the 北來道人. He is co-present with them at 瓦官寺.
records.referent_role: 孫興公 (Sun Xinggong, a person)

records.explanation: 此道人 refers back to the 北來道人 (the Daoist monk from the north) mentioned earlier in the text. It is a local anaphoric reference anchored to sfh1-mention-1c58ac632cebc5dc5931886e. This person is distinct from 林公, 竺法深, 孫興公, and 深公.
records.referent_role: the Daoist monk from the north who debated with Lin Gong

records.explanation: 殷中軍 refers to Yin Hao (殷浩) by his office title 中軍 (General of the Central Army). This is an office holder reference. He is distinct from 神農 who appears in the annotation text.
records.referent_role: person holding the office of 中軍 (General of the Central Army)

records.explanation: 神農 (Shennong) is a legendary sage-ruler in Chinese mythology, referenced in the Liu Xiaobiao annotation citing the 神農書 (Shennong's book). This is a ruler reference to the mythical emperor. It is distinct from 殷中軍 who appears in the main text.
records.referent_role: legendary sage-ruler / cultural hero

records.explanation: 莊周 (Zhuangzi) is a direct full-name reference to the philosopher Zhuang Zhou. He is distinct from the surname 莊 in annotation 002 which refers to 莊周 as one of the '二子' (two masters) alongside 老 (Laozi). The annotation mentions 莊周 in the context of 支法師's study of Zhuangzi's 逍遥 concept.
records.referent_role: referenced_person

records.explanation: 七沙門 refers to the seven Buddhist monks (including 支遁) who are compared to the 竹林七賢 (Seven Worthies of the Bamboo Grove) in the 道賢論. This is a collective descriptive reference, distinct from the group of Seven Worthies.
records.referent_role: referenced_group

records.explanation: 支 is the surname abbreviation of 支道林, used in the phrase 支道林㧞新領異... and later 孫與支共載. It corefers with the full name 支道林.
records.referent_role: 支道林 (Zhi Daolin)

records.explanation: 向秀 (Xiang Xiu) is a direct full-name reference to the Wei-Jin philosopher. The annotation compares 支遁 (Zhi Dun) to 向秀, noting both admired Zhuangzi and Laozi. He is distinct from 莊 and 老.
records.referent_role: referenced_person

records.explanation: 孫興公 is the full name of Sun Xinggong, who speaks to Wang about Zhi Daolin. He is distinct from both Wang and Zhi.
records.referent_role: 孫興公 (Sun Xinggong)

records.explanation: 支法師 is an office/title reference to 支道林 (Zhi Daolin), the Buddhist monk. The annotation discusses his study of Zhuangzi's 逍遥 concept. This refers to the same person as 支道林 in the main text.
records.referent_role: referenced_person

records.explanation: 王 is the surname abbreviation of 王逸少 (Wang Xizhi), appearing at the start of the main text. It refers to the same person as the full name 王逸少.
records.referent_role: 王逸少 (Wang Xizhi)

君 is the second-person pronoun used by 支道林 when addressing 王逸少. 支語王曰君未可去 (Zhi said to Wang: 'You may not leave yet').
records.referent_role: 王逸少 (Wang Xizhi)

records.explanation: 竹林七賢 refers to the Seven Worthies of the Bamboo Grove, a famous group of Wei-Jin literati. This is a collective descriptive reference, distinct from the group of seven Buddhist monks (七沙門).
records.referent_role: referenced_group

records.explanation: 王逸少 is the full name of Wang Xizhi (Wang Yishao), the protagonist of the main text. He is coreferent with the surname 王 in the main text. He is distinct from 支道林 and 孫興公.
records.referent_role: referenced_person

records.explanation: 莊 is a surname abbreviation referring to 莊周 (Zhuangzi), coreferent with the full name 莊周 in annotation 001. It appears in the phrase 莊老二子 (the two masters Zhuang and Lao), paired with 老.
records.referent_role: referenced_person

records.explanation: 老 is a surname abbreviation referring to 老子 (Laozi). It appears in the phrase 莊老二子 (the two masters Zhuang and Lao), paired with 莊. Laozi is distinct from Zhuangzi and from 向秀.
records.referent_role: referenced_person

records.explanation: 貧道 is a humble self-reference used by Buddhist monks. Here 支道林 uses it to refer to himself when speaking to 王逸少: 貧道與君小語 (let me have a brief talk with you). It corefers with 支道林.
records.referent_role: 支道林 (Zhi Daolin) self-reference

records.explanation: 支道林 is the full name of the Buddhist monk Zhi Daolin, introduced at the beginning of the story as being present at 㑹稽.
records.referent_role: 支道林 (Zhi Daolin)

records.explanation: 簡文 is the ruler title for Emperor Jianwen (司馬昱), who speaks (云) about the attainment of sagehood (聖人). He is distinct from the sage category and from the collective 衆 in the annotation.
records.referent_role: Emperor Jianwen (簡文), the ruler

records.explanation: 衆 in the Liu annotation refers to 'all beings' (一切衆生), a collective descriptive reference in the Buddhist context of the annotation, distinct from the 聖人 in the main text.
records.referent_role: collective referent (all sentient beings)

records.explanation: 聖人 refers to the category of sages who can be attained through spiritual cultivation, per the Buddhist teaching cited. It is a descriptive person reference distinct from the collective 衆 in the annotation.
records.referent_role: sage (聖人), a category of enlightened person

records.referent_role: person referred to by abbreviated name

汰法師 in the main text is an office title (法師) with the name 汰, referring to the same person as 法汰. This is the main text reference to the monk 法汰.
records.referent_role: Buddhist master 汰法師 (Master 汰)

records.explanation: 法汰 is the personal name of the monk, same person as the earlier 法汰 mention. The annotation explicitly states 一説法汰即安公弟子 (one says 法汰 is 安公's disciple).
records.referent_role: person referred to by personal name 法汰

records.explanation: 安法師 is an office title (法師) with surname 安, referring to the Buddhist master 安公 (安道林/安公). He is the teacher of 法汰. The annotation states 法汰即安公弟子.
records.referent_role: Buddhist master (法師) named 安

records.explanation: 安公 is an honorific reference to Master An (安道林/安公), the same person as 安法師. The annotation states 法汰即安公弟子, making 安公 the teacher of 法汰.
records.referent_role: Buddhist master 安公 (Master An)

records.explanation: 竺 is a surname reference appearing in the annotation (安法師傳曰竺...). It refers to a person with surname 竺, likely 竺法汰 (the full name of 法汰), but the text is fragmentary. It appears in the context of 安法師傳 (biography of Master An). Given the fragmentary nature, this could be the surname of 法汰 (竺法汰), but the evidence is incomplete.
records.referent_role: person with surname 竺

records.explanation: 法汰 is the personal name of the monk (法汰). The annotation text identifies him as 安公弟子 (disciple of 安公). He is distinct from 安法師/安公 who is his teacher.
records.referent_role: person referred to by personal name 法汰

records.explanation: 法師 in the annotation (簡道情冥到法師友而善焉) refers to a Buddhist master. Given the context of the annotation discussing 法汰, this 法師 likely refers to 法汰 himself, who is described as a friend (友) of 簡道情. The annotation says 一説法汰即安公弟子, suggesting 法汰 is the subject being discussed.
records.referent_role: Buddhist master (法師)

records.explanation: 其人 is an anaphoric pronoun referring back to the 俗士 (vulgar scholar) mentioned in the same annotation passage. The context shows 嘗與俗士相牾其人攘袂而起, where 其人 clearly refers to the 俗士.
records.referent_role: referent

二豪 refers to the two grandees mentioned earlier in the ode, namely 貴介公子 and 縉紳處士, who attend beside the 先生. They are distinct from the 先生/劉伶.
records.referent_role: the two grandees/豪 (貴介公子 and 縉紳處士) attending beside the 先生

records.explanation: 伯倫 is the courtesy name (字) of 劉伶, as stated in the annotation 伶字伯倫. It refers to the same person as 劉伶 and 伶.
records.referent_role: referent

records.explanation: 伶 is an abbreviated reference to 劉伶 (Liu Ling), the subject of the story. The annotation states 伶字伯倫, linking 伶 to his courtesy name 伯倫. This is the same person as 劉伶 in the main text.
records.referent_role: referent

人 in the annotation context (使人荷鍤隨之) refers to a servant or attendant who carries the spade for 劉伶. This is a generic descriptive reference to a person, not specifically identified.
records.referent_role: referent

records.explanation: 俗士 is a descriptive reference to a vulgar/common scholar who clashed with 劉伶. This is distinct from 劉伶 himself, as the text says 嘗與俗士相牾 (once clashed with a vulgar scholar).
records.referent_role: referent

records.explanation: 劉伶 is the full name of the author of the 酒徳頌. The annotation identifies him as 伶 with courtesy name 伯倫. The 先生 in the ode is the persona of Liu Ling himself, so they corefer. The 二豪 are distinct from Liu Ling.
records.referent_role: Liu Ling (劉伶), the author of the 酒徳頌

records.explanation: 先生 in the 酒徳頌 text refers to the persona of the ode, which is Liu Ling (劉伶) himself. The 二豪 (two grandees) are described as attending at his side (侍側), indicating co-presence but distinctness. The 先生 is the author-persona of the ode, coreferent with 劉伶.
records.referent_role: the subject of the wine virtue ode (酒徳頌), i.e., the persona/author figure

records.explanation: 安石 is the personal name (字) form of 謝安石, appearing in 桓公's speech '此是安石碎金'. Corefers with 謝安石 and 安.
records.referent_role: 謝安石 (Xie An), referred to by personal name 安石

records.explanation: 謝安石 is the full name form of Xie An (字安石). He authored the 諡議 that 桓公 reads. Corefers with 安石 and 安.
records.referent_role: 謝安石 (Xie An), author of the 諡議

records.explanation: 諸客 is a collective descriptive reference to the guests present. They are the recipients of 桓公's action and speech, distinct from all named individuals.
records.referent_role: the guests seated (諸客) to whom 桓公 throws the proposal

records.explanation: 安 in the annotation refers to 謝安 (Xie An), the same person as 謝安石 and 安石 in the main text. The annotation quotes 劉謙之's 晉紀 recording 安's 議 (proposal).
records.referent_role: person who proposed the posthumous name (the subject of 議)

records.explanation: The mention 親 appears in the phrase '以禮侍親可稱爲孝' (serving one's parents/elders with propriety can be called filial). Here 親 refers to the parent(s)/elder(s) whom the crown prince (太子/皇太子) serves with filial piety. It is a compositional kinship term referring to the object of filial service, distinct from the crown prince himself. The context is 温嶠 (Wen Qiao) responding to 王敦's questioning about the crown prince's character, saying that the crown prince serves his parents with propriety, which constitutes filial piety. The 親 here is the parent of the crown prince — in context, likely referring to 明帝's father (the emperor), though the specific identity is not named in this passage. The kinship relation is anchored by the crown prince (太子) serving 親 with propriety.
records.referent_role: the person being served with filial piety (the emperor's parent/elder)

王導 is Wang Dao, a historical figure cited alongside Zhuge Liang as a precedent in the imperial edict for Huan Wen's expected conduct. He is distinct from Huan Wen, Zhuge Liang, and Emperor Jianwen.
records.referent_role: 王導 (Wang Dao), historical figure cited as precedent

records.explanation: 簡文 is the ruler title for Emperor Jianwen (司馬昱). The annotation states that upon 簡文's death (晏駕), the edict (遺詔) instructed 桓温 to follow the precedents of 諸葛亮 and 王導. 簡文 is the ruler who issued the edict, distinct from 謝安, 王坦之, and 桓温.
records.referent_role: referent

records.explanation: 安 in the Liu annotation (安/晉) is an abbreviated reference to 謝安 (Xie An), coreferent with the full name 謝安 in annotation 002 and the main text. It is distinct from 王坦之 and 桓温.
records.referent_role: referent

records.explanation: 王坦之 is the full name of Wang Tanzhi, one of the two officials Huan Gong (Huan Wen) plots to kill. He is distinct from Xie An (謝安) and from Huan Gong (桓公). The surname 王 (07e369dd) in the main text refers to him, and 坦之 (543f278c) in annotation 005 also refers to him.
records.referent_role: person being targeted by Huan Gong's plot

records.explanation: 朝士 is a descriptive collective reference to the court officials who were broadly invited by 桓公. 謝安 and 王坦之 are among the 朝士, but the collective term itself refers to the group as a whole, not specifically to them.
records.referent_role: court officials (朝士), the collective group invited by 桓公

records.explanation: 坦之 is the abbreviated personal name of Wang Tanzhi (王坦之), whose courtesy name is 文度. He is one of the two officials summoned by Huan Wen. He is distinct from Huan Wen and from the collective 阿堵軰.
records.referent_role: 王坦之 (Wang Tanzhi), courtesy name 文度

records.explanation: 宋明帝 is a ruler title referring to Emperor Ming of Song (Liu Song dynasty). He is the author of the 文章志 (Wenzhang Zhi) work being cited. He is distinct from 安 (Xie An) who is the subject of the quoted text.
records.referent_role: ruler/emperor

records.explanation: 桓温 is the full name of Huan Wen, the central figure in the annotation. He is distinct from Zhuge Liang and Wang Dao, who are cited as precedents (故事) for his expected conduct. He corefers with 温 (personal name), 桓温 (full name in annotation 005), 温 (personal name in annotation 006), 桓公 (honorific in main text), and 桓 (surname in main text).
records.referent_role: 桓温 (Huan Wen), the subject of the annotation passage describing his actions

records.explanation: 温 is the abbreviated personal name of 桓温, appearing immediately after the full name 桓温 in the same annotation passage. It refers to the same person, Huan Wen.
records.referent_role: 桓温 (Huan Wen), abbreviated personal name

records.explanation: The surname 王 in the Liu annotation '自此欲殺王謝' refers to 王坦之 (Wang Tanzhi), paired with 謝 (Xie An). It is an abbreviated surname reference for Wang Tanzhi, distinct from the 謝 surname reference referring to Xie An.
records.referent_role: 王坦之 (Wang Tanzhi)

records.explanation: 温 in the Liu annotation refers to 桓温, the person being addressed by 安 (謝安). It is a personal name reference to Huan Wen, coreferent with the full name 桓温 in the same annotation and with 桓公 in the main text.
records.referent_role: 桓温 (Huan Wen)

名流 is a descriptive collective reference to famous literati who imitated Xie An's (安) recitation style. They are distinct from Xie An himself, as they are the ones imitating him.
records.referent_role: collective group of famous/celebrated literati

records.explanation: The surname 謝 in the Liu annotation '自此欲殺王謝' refers to 謝安 (Xie An), paired with 王 (Wang Tanzhi). It is an abbreviated surname reference for Xie An, distinct from the 王 surname reference referring to Wang Tanzhi.
records.referent_role: 謝安 (Xie An)

records.explanation: 安 here is the abbreviated personal name of Xie An (謝安), referenced in the Liu annotation quoting 宋明帝文章志. The text says 安能作洛下書生詠, describing Xie An's ability to recite in the Luoxia scholar style. This is the same person as 安 in annotation 005 and the 謝安 in the main text.
records.referent_role: person being described

records.explanation: 桓温 is the full name of Huan Wen in the Liu annotation. He is the one who stopped at Xinting, set up troops, and summoned An and Tanzhi intending to harm them. He is distinct from Tanzhi and from the collective 阿堵軰 (those guards). He is the speaker in the exchange with 明公 (addressed to him).
records.referent_role: 桓温 (Huan Wen), the general/regent who set up the ambush

records.explanation: 王坦之 is the full name of Wang Tanzhi in the Liu annotation. He is coreferent with 坦之 and 王 elsewhere. He is distinct from 謝安 and 桓温. The annotation mentions 謝安 and 王坦之 together as co-builders related to 簡文's edict.
records.referent_role: referent

records.explanation: 桓公 is an honorific reference to 桓温 (Huan Wen), the Duke of Huan. It is coreferent with the full name 桓温 in the Liu annotations and with the surname 桓 in the main text. 桓公 is distinct from 謝安 and 王坦之 who are the targets of his plot.
records.referent_role: 桓温 (Huan Wen)

records.explanation: No valid semantic record was returned; fail closed.

謝安 is the full name of Xie An in the Liu annotation. He is coreferent with 安 elsewhere. He is distinct from 王坦之 and 桓温. The annotation mentions that 謝安 and 王坦之 together built/established something (所建也) related to 簡文's edict.
records.referent_role: referent

records.explanation: 諸葛亮 is Zhuge Liang, a historical figure cited in the imperial edict (遺詔) as a precedent for how Huan Wen should behave. He is distinct from Huan Wen and from Wang Dao, who is also cited as a precedent in the same phrase.
records.referent_role: 諸葛亮 (Zhuge Liang), historical figure cited as precedent

records.explanation: 桓 is the surname of 桓公 (Huan Gong), referring to 桓温. It is an abbreviated form of the honorific 桓公 that immediately follows in the text. 桓公 is the subject who sets the trap against 謝安 and 王坦之.
records.referent_role: 桓温 (Huan Wen), the general who set the trap

records.explanation: 阿堵軰 is a collective descriptive reference to Huan Wen's guards stationed around the walls ('those fellows in the walls'). They belong to/are under Huan Wen's command. They are distinct from Huan Wen himself, from Tanzhi, and from the honorific 明公 (which refers to Huan Wen).
records.referent_role: Collective reference to Huan Wen's guards/attendants (阿堵軰 = 'those fellows'), the armed guards stationed around Huan Wen

在位望者 is a descriptive collective reference to officials in positions of authority who trembled in fear at the occasion. It is a collective group distinct from the specific individuals 王 (Wang Tanzhi) and 謝 (Xie An), though they are co-present at the same event.
records.referent_role: collective group of officials in positions of authority present at the occasion

謝安南 refers to 謝奉 by his office title 安南將軍. The Liu annotation confirms 謝奉 held the office 安南將軍. This is the same person as 謝奉 in the main text.

records.explanation: 父鳯 means father 鳯. The annotation states 父鳯丞相主簿, indicating 鳯 is the father of 謝奉. This is a kinship relation distinct from 謝奉 himself.
records.referent_role: father of 謝奉, named 鳯

records.explanation: This is the full name 謝奉 with courtesy name 弘道 given in the Liu annotation. It refers to the same person as 謝奉 (sfh1-mention-0bc806bd76dd0c2ba521f980), 弘道 (sfh1-mention-d2f38422b3bd9ecbc1eaf26e), and the 謝奉 in the main text (sfh1-mention-53dd82a2bdebdcf7f6448505).
records.referent_role: person named 謝奉, courtesy name 弘道

records.explanation: 同舟 is a descriptive collective reference to the people traveling on the same boat as 謝太傅. It is a group reference, distinct from the individual persons mentioned. 謝太傅 speaks to them, saying 謝奉故是竒士.
records.referent_role: collective reference to fellow travelers on the same boat

records.explanation: 謝太傅 refers to 謝安 by his office title 太傅. He is distinct from 謝安南 (謝奉). The main text describes them meeting (相遇) on the road.
records.referent_role: person holding office 太傅, i.e., 謝安 (謝太傅)

records.explanation: 弘道 is the courtesy name of 謝奉, appearing in the same annotation as 謝奉字弘道. It refers to the same person.
records.referent_role: person named 謝奉, courtesy name 弘道

records.explanation: 安南 is the abbreviated office title within 謝安南, referring to the same person 謝奉 who held the office 安南將軍.
records.referent_role: person holding office 安南將軍, i.e., 謝奉

王 is a surname-only reference that abbreviates 王恭, referring to the same person. In the phrase 王讀殷笑之不自勝, Wang reads the piece while Yin laughs uncontrollably, then Wang finishes reading without commenting.
records.referent_role: 王恭, same person as 王恭

records.explanation: 王恭 is the full name of Wang Gong, who is addressed by Yin Zhongkan. The surname 王 later in the text refers to the same person. Wang Gong reads the new piece of writing and reacts differently from Yin.
records.referent_role: 王恭, Wang Gong

records.explanation: 殷 is a surname-only reference that abbreviates 殷荆州, referring to the same person (Yin Zhongkan). It appears in the phrase 殷甚以爲有才, continuing the narrative about the same individual.

殷荆州 is an office title reference to Yin Zhongkan (殷仲堪), the governor of Jingzhou. It refers to the same person as the surname reference 殷 later in the text. The text describes him having an acquaintance who wrote a fu in the style of Shu Xi's playful works, and then speaking to Wang Gong about a new piece of writing.
records.referent_role: 殷仲堪, governor of Jingzhou (荆州刺史)

records.explanation: 所繼從舅 is a compositional kinship term meaning 'adoptive maternal uncle'. It refers to 羊祜 (Yang Hu), who is the 所繼從舅 of 夷甫 (Wang Yifu). The kinship relation is directly stated in the annotation: 夷甫年十七見所繼從舅羊祜.
records.referent_role: referent

records.explanation: 賔 (guests) is a collective descriptive reference to the assembled guests. 祜 turns and speaks to the guests (祜顧謂賔). The guests are distinct from 祜 and 夷甫, being the audience at the gathering.
records.referent_role: referent

records.explanation: 祜 is the abbreviated personal name of 羊祜 (Yang Hu). In annotation-002, 祜 disagrees with the guest's assessment of 此人 (夷甫), and then turns to address the guests (賔). 祜 is distinct from 夷甫.
records.referent_role: referent

records.explanation: 王戎 (Wang Rong) is a full name reference. He is one of the '二王' (Two Wangs) together with Wang Yifu, and is distinct from both Wang Yifu (甫) and Yang Hu (祜). The annotation mentions that Yang Hu wanted to execute Wang Rong under military law.
records.referent_role: 王戎 (Wang Rong)

records.explanation: 行人 is a collective descriptive reference to messengers or officials dispatched on official business. The text says 有公事使行人論不得時, meaning 'had official business and sent messengers to discuss but could not get a timely resolution.' This refers to a group of people sent by 父乂, not a specific individual.
records.referent_role: collective reference to messengers/officials sent on official business

records.explanation: 山濤 is the full name of the person holding the office of 尚書 (Shangshu). The office title 尚書 immediately precedes 山濤. The short form 濤 later in the text refers to the same person 山濤.
records.referent_role: person holding office of 尚書 (Shangshu)

records.explanation: 濤 is the abbreviated personal name (single character from the full name 山濤) referring to the same person as 山濤. In the main text, 濤 appears after 山濤 has been introduced, and the context '濤甚奇之' (Tao greatly admired him) refers to 山濤's reaction to 夷甫.
records.referent_role: person 山濤 (Shan Tao)

records.explanation: 甫 is an abbreviated form of 王夷甫 (Wang Yifu). In the annotation context, 甫 refers to Wang Yifu who is angry at 祜 (Yang Hu) for predicting his downfall. The '二王' (Two Wangs) refers to Wang Yifu and Wang Rong together, so 甫 is distinct from 王戎.
records.referent_role: 王夷甫 (Wang Yifu)

records.explanation: 世人 is a collective descriptive reference to the people of the world who praise Yang Hu's virtue ('稱羊公之有德'). It is distinct from 羊公 as the subject of the praising action.
records.referent_role: the people of the world / the general public

records.explanation: 父乂 is a kinship reference meaning 'father Yi'. It refers to Wang Yi (王乂), the father of Wang Yifu (夷甫). The annotation states 夷甫父乂有簡書將免官, confirming the father-son relationship. In the main text, 父乂 holds the office of 平北將軍.
records.referent_role: referent

records.explanation: No valid semantic record was returned; fail closed.

此人 refers to 夷甫 (Wang Yifu), as the guest says this person will achieve great fame. The context in annotation-002 shows 祜 (Yang Hu) responding to this statement about 夷甫. The 客 (guest) is speaking about 此人, and 祜 disagrees (不然之), then 夷甫 leaves angrily (拂衣而起).
records.referent_role: referent

records.explanation: 夷甫 is the abbreviated personal name of Wang Yifu (王夷甫). In the Liu annotation, he is described as visiting his 所繼從舅 (adoptive maternal uncle) 羊祜, and his 父乂 (father Yi) is mentioned. The kinship relations are directly stated in the annotation text.
records.referent_role: referent

records.explanation: 羊祜 is the full name of Yang Hu. In the Liu annotation, he is identified as the 所繼從舅 of 夷甫. In the main text, he holds the office of 僕射 (Puye). The kinship relation with 夷甫 and the office relation are directly stated.
records.referent_role: referent

records.explanation: 祜 is the abbreviated personal name of 羊祜 (Yang Hu). In this annotation, 祜 refers to Yang Hu who spoke about Wang Yifu's inevitable failure and who earlier wanted to execute Wang Rong under military law.
records.referent_role: 羊祜 (Yang Hu)

records.explanation: 羊公 is an honorific reference to 羊祜 (Yang Hu), using the respectful suffix 公. The annotation text '稱羊公之有德' indicates people (世人) praise Yang Hu's virtue, calling him 羊公.
records.referent_role: 羊祜 (Yang Hu), referred to with honorific 公

records.explanation: 僕射 is an office title. The text reads 見僕射羊祜尚書山濤, meaning 'visited 僕射 Yang Hu and 尚書 Shan Tao.' The office 僕射 is held by 羊祜, who immediately follows in the text. This is an office holder reference anchored to 羊祜.
records.referent_role: office title 僕射 held by 羊祜

records.explanation: 父乂 is a compositional kinship reference meaning 'father Yi' (Wang Yi, father of Wang Yifu). The text states 王夷甫父乂爲平北將軍, so 父乂 is the father of 王夷甫 and holds the office of 平北將軍. This corefers with 父乂 in the Liu annotation (sfh1-mention-61ccc5ee8bf31966e27ac957).
records.referent_role: father of 王夷甫 (Wang Yifu)

records.explanation: No valid semantic record was returned; fail closed.
No valid semantic record was returned; fail closed.
尚書 is the office title held by 山濤, who immediately follows in the text. The office title 尚書 modifies 山濤, indicating 山濤 holds the office of Shangshu. This is distinct from 羊祜 who holds 僕射.
records.referent_role: person holding office of 尚書 (Shangshu)

records.explanation: 二王 (the Two Wangs) is a collective descriptive reference to Wang Yifu (王夷甫) and Wang Rong (王戎), the two Wangs mentioned together in the world's saying. It is distinct from Yang Hu (祜).
records.referent_role: 王夷甫 and 王戎 (the two Wangs)

records.explanation: 平北將軍 is an office title. The text says 王夷甫父乂爲平北將軍, so the holder of this office is 父乂 (Wang Yi), the father of Wang Yifu. This is an office holder reference anchored to 父乂.
records.referent_role: office title 平北將軍 held by 父乂 (Wang Yi)

records.explanation: 夷甫 is the abbreviated personal name of 王夷甫 (Wang Yifu). In annotation-002, after 祜 disagrees with the guest's assessment, 夷甫 angrily leaves (拂衣而起). 夷甫 is the same person as 此人 (the guest's referent) and is distinct from 祜.
records.referent_role: referent

records.explanation: 潘淊 is the full name of the person also called 陽仲 (courtesy name). He is the 從子 of 太常尼. This is the same person as 潘陽仲 in the main text.
records.referent_role: person being described (潘淊)

records.explanation: 太傅 here refers to the office held by 潘淊 (潘陽仲). The same office title 太傅 appears again in annotation-003 referring to the same office.
records.referent_role: office title 太傅 held by 潘淊

records.explanation: 同僚 is a collective descriptive reference indicating that the 舍人 and 淊 were colleagues. It anchors to both mentions and expresses their social relationship.
records.referent_role: 同僚 - colleagues (舍人 and 淊)

records.explanation: 太 is the truncated form of 太傅, referring to the same office title as 太傅 in annotation-002 and annotation-003. It refers to the office held by 潘淊.
records.referent_role: abbreviated form of 太傅 (office title)

records.explanation: 太常尼 is an office title (太常) with personal name 尼. This is the person 潘尼, who held the office of 太常. The annotation states 潘淊 is 尼's 從子 (nephew).
records.referent_role: office holder (太常)

records.explanation: 王處仲 is the courtesy name of 王敦. The text in annotation-003 quotes someone (likely 潘淊) speaking about 王處仲's appearance, saying his bee-like eyes are already visible and his jackal voice has not yet emerged.
records.referent_role: 王敦 (Wang Dun), referred to by courtesy name 王處仲

records.explanation: 王夷甫 (Wang Yanfu) is a person who spoke to 東海王越 about transferring 王敦 to 揚州. He is distinct from 東海王越 and 王敦.
records.referent_role: person (王夷甫)

records.explanation: No valid semantic record was returned; fail closed.
太傅 in annotation-003 refers to the same office as 太傅 in annotation-002, held by 潘淊. 王敦 speaks to this 太傅.
records.referent_role: office title 太傅 held by 潘淊

records.explanation: 河南尹 is the office held by 潘淊 at the end of the Yongjia era, as stated in annotation-002.
records.referent_role: office title 河南尹 held by 潘淊

records.explanation: 陽仲 is the courtesy name (字) of 潘淊. The annotation 晉陽秋曰潘淊字陽仲 confirms this. Same person as 潘淊 and 潘陽仲.
records.referent_role: courtesy name of 潘淊

records.explanation: 王敦 is the person transferred to 揚州 by 東海王越. Same person as 王處仲 (courtesy name) and 敦 (short form) in later annotations, and 王敦 in the main text.
records.referent_role: person (王敦)

records.explanation: 楚令尹子上 is an office-holder reference: 令尹 is the office (Chu prime minister) and 子上 is the person's name. He is the speaker who addresses 世子商臣.
records.referent_role: 楚令尹子上 (Chu lingyin Zishang)

records.explanation: 忍人也 is a descriptive person reference characterizing 世子商臣 as a ruthless person. It anchors to and corefers with 世子商臣, describing his nature.
records.referent_role: 忍人也 - descriptive characterization of 世子商臣

records.explanation: 淊 is an abbreviated reference to 潘淊 (Pan Tao), whose full name appears in annotation 001 and 002. The text says 子舍人與淊同僚, meaning the retainer and 淊 were colleagues.
records.referent_role: 潘淊 (Pan Tao)

records.explanation: 滎陽人 describes 潘淊 (潘陽仲) as a person from 滎陽. It is a descriptive reference identifying the same person as 潘淊 and 陽仲 in the annotation.
records.referent_role: origin/place of origin

records.explanation: 潘淊 in annotation-002 is the same person as 潘淊/陽仲 in annotation-001 and 潘陽仲 in the main text. He held the office of 太傅 and later 河南尹.
records.referent_role: person being discussed (潘淊, also known as 潘陽仲)

records.explanation: 世子商臣 is a ruler reference (heir apparent of Chu). He is the object of 子上's speech, described as having 蜂目而豺聲 (bee eyes and jackal voice), a 忍人 (ruthless person).
records.referent_role: 世子商臣 (heir apparent Shangchen)

records.explanation: 從子 is a kinship term meaning nephew. It refers to 潘淊, who is the nephew of 太常尼 (潘尼). The kinship relation is anchored to 太常尼.
records.referent_role: nephew (從子)

records.explanation: 君 is a second-person pronoun used by 潘陽仲 (潘淊) addressing 王敦 directly in the main text. The sentence reads '潘陽仲見王敦小時謂曰君蜂目巳露...' — Pan Yangzhong saw Wang Dun when young and said to him 'you (君) have the bee eyes already showing...'. Thus 君 refers to 王敦 (sfh1-mention-702ff31af272da57a59a64aa), the addressee of the speech, and is distinct from the speaker 潘陽仲 (sfh1-mention-ef5970e3074ed7bfeec689ac). records.explanation: 朝廷之望 is a descriptive collective reference describing 鯤's status as a hope/expectation of the court. It is anchored to 鯤 (謝鯤) who is described as being 朝廷之望.

records.explanation: 二弟 refers to the two younger brothers of 王丞相 (Wang Dao). The kinship term 弟 is anchored to 王丞相 as the elder brother/possessor. The two brothers are 潁 and 敝, who follow in the text.

records.explanation: 謝淵 is the full name of Xie Yuan, one of the Xie cousins. The annotation glosses 遏末 as referring to 謝淵 (遏) and 韶 (末). 謝淵 is distinct from 謝韶.

records.referent_role: 孫恩, a rebel leader who caused the death of 袁山松

records.explanation: 王珣 in the Liu annotation is the same person as 王珣 in the main text (sfh1-mention-61a8e1c4bb940c374dd007af) and 珣 (sfh1-mention-a149aba7a88e5d64a9fc1f34). The emperor consults Wang Xun about a son-in-law, and Wang Xun recommends Xie Hun. Wang Xun is distinct from the emperor and from Xie Hun.
records.referent_role: Wang Xun (王珣), the person consulted about a son-in-law

records.explanation: 謝混 is the person Wang Xun recommends as a son-in-law candidate. It corefers with the 謝混 in the Liu annotation (sfh1-mention-9da40f3f6ac164e8f11067e9). It is distinct from 真長, 子敬, and 袁山松.
records.referent_role: 謝混 (Xie Hun), the person recommended by 王珣 as son-in-law

records.explanation: 父方平 is a kinship reference meaning 'father Fangping'. The context is the genealogy of 袁山松 (山松): 祖喬 (grandfather Qiao), 父方平 (father Fangping). The 父 indicates the father of 山松. The name 方平 is the father's personal name.
records.referent_role: father of 山松 (袁山松)

records.explanation: 王珣 (Wang Xun) is the official whom Emperor Xiaowu commissions to find a son-in-law. He is the same person as 珣 (sfh1-mention-74fd897c7696b18cbf4ee97d) in the main text and 王珣/珣 in the Liu annotation (sfh1-mention-5c4cc594a906e83cb56bc26b, sfh1-mention-a149aba7a88e5d64a9fc1f34). He is distinct from the emperor and from Xie Hun. The surname 王 (sfh1-mention-c01d696174a149a350d5876c) is part of his name, not a separate person.
records.referent_role: official commissioned to find son-in-law

records.explanation: The character 山 in the Liu annotation (秋曰山/續晉陽) appears to be an abbreviated reference to 袁山松, whose full name appears in the main text. The annotation fragment '秋曰山' likely refers to 袁山松's name being abbreviated.
records.referent_role: person referred to by single character 山, likely part of 袁山松's name

records.explanation: No valid semantic record was returned; fail closed.

珣 is the abbreviated personal name for 王珣 (Wang Xun), who appears in full form at the start of the main text and in the Liu annotation. He is the one asked by Emperor Xiaowu to recommend a son-in-law, and he recommends 謝混.
records.referent_role: 王珣 (Wang Xun), the official being asked by Emperor Xiaowu to find a son-in-law

records.explanation: 桓温 is a full name reference to Huan Wen, mentioned alongside 王敦 as examples of the '磊砢之流' that Emperor Xiaowu considers unsuitable. He is distinct from 王敦 and from 王珣.
records.referent_role: 桓温 (Huan Wen), historical figure mentioned as an example of unsuitable son-in-law type

records.explanation: 陳郡人 is a descriptive reference indicating the native place (陳郡) of the person being described, which is 袁山松. It describes the same person as 松/山松.
records.referent_role: person being described (袁山松's origin)

records.explanation: 真長 is the courtesy name of Liu Zhenchang (劉惔). In the annotation '真長不減子敬', it refers to the same person as 真長 in the main text. The annotation compares 真長 with 子敬 (Wang Xianzhi), indicating they are distinct persons.
records.referent_role: 真長 (Liu Zhenchang / 劉惔), courtesy name reference

records.explanation: 祖喬 is a kinship reference meaning 'grandfather 喬'. The grandfather 喬 held the office of 益州刺史. The office relation is explicit in the text.
records.referent_role: grandfather of 袁山松 (named 喬)

records.explanation: 謝混 is the person Wang Xun recommends as a son-in-law candidate. In the Liu annotation, 王珣舉謝混 (Wang Xun recommends Xie Hun). This is the same person as 謝混 in the main text (sfh1-mention-5d6d3cb3dc207688076d5504).
records.referent_role: person being recommended as son-in-law candidate

records.explanation: 珣 is the abbreviated personal name of 王珣 (Wang Xun), coreferring with the full name mention sfh1-mention-5c4cc594a906e83cb56bc26b in the same annotation and with 王珣 in the main text. Wang Xun recommends Xie Hun (謝混).
records.referent_role: Wang Xun (王珣), abbreviated as 珣

records.explanation: 松 is an abbreviated form of 山松 (袁山松), referring to the same person. The annotation describes his lineage: grandfather 喬, father 方平. The kinship relations are explicit in the text.
records.referent_role: person being described (袁山松)

records.explanation: The surname 王 is the first character of 王珣's full name in the main text. It is an abbreviated reference to the same person as 王珣 (sfh1-mention-61a8e1c4bb940c374dd007af), not a separate individual. It anchors to the full name mention.
records.referent_role: surname component of 王珣's name

records.explanation: The pronoun 卿 is used by 孝武 (the emperor) to address 袁山松. In the main text, after 袁山松 is mentioned as wanting to imitate 謝混's marriage, the emperor (王) says '卿莫近禁臠' — 'you must not approach the forbidden delicacy.' The 卿 refers to 袁山松, who is the one being addressed. The speaker is 孝武 (the emperor), who is distinct from the addressee.
records.referent_role: addressee

records.explanation: 山松 is the abbreviated personal name for 袁山松. The annotation describes his genealogy: grandfather Qiao (益州刺史), father Fangping (義興太守). This 山松 in the annotation refers to the same person as 袁山松 in the main text.
records.referent_role: 袁山松 (Yuan Shansong), the person whose genealogy is being described

records.explanation: 益州刺史 is an office title. The holder is 祖喬 (the grandfather of 袁山松). This is distinct from 義興太守 which is held by 父方平.
records.referent_role: office title (益州刺史) held by 祖喬

records.explanation: 磊砢之流 is a descriptive collective reference to the category of people exemplified by 王敦 and 桓温. Emperor Xiaowu says such types are not what he needs for a son-in-law. It is a collective category, distinct from the individual named persons and from 王珣.
records.referent_role: Collective reference to the type of people like 王敦 and 桓温 (rough/unruly types)

records.explanation: 晉陵公主 is a princess title. The text '初帝為晉陵公主' indicates the emperor was arranging a marriage for her. She is the emperor's daughter (patron/possessor relationship with the emperor).
records.referent_role: 晉陵公主, a princess (daughter of the emperor)

records.explanation: 子敬 is the courtesy name of Wang Xianzhi. In the Liu annotation, 真長不減子敬 compares Zhenchang (Liu Tan) with Zijing (Wang Xianzhi), indicating they are distinct persons. The main text also has 子敬 at sfh1-mention-7077639f240697b5e13fa339 referring to the same person.
records.referent_role: person referred to by courtesy name 子敬 (Wang Xianzhi)

records.explanation: 王敦 is a full name reference to Wang Dun, mentioned alongside 桓温 as examples of the '磊砢之流' (rough/unruly types) that Emperor Xiaowu says are not suitable as sons-in-law. He is distinct from 桓温 and from 王珣.
records.referent_role: 王敦 (Wang Dun), historical figure mentioned as an example of unsuitable son-in-law type

records.explanation: 周伯仁 is the full name of Zhou Boren, the person addressed by 庾元規. Coreferent with 周 (surname reference).
records.referent_role: Zhou Boren (周伯仁), the addressee

records.explanation: 將軍 is an office title. The context '昭王將軍率諸侯伐齊' indicates the general serves under 昭王. The annotation continues '樂毅中山人賢而為燕', identifying the general as 樂毅.
records.referent_role: General (樂毅) under 昭王

records.explanation: 樂毅 is the full name of the general. The annotation '樂毅中山人賢而為燕' identifies him as the person from Zhongshan who served Yan. He corefers with 將軍 and 中山人.
records.referent_role: 樂毅, the general of Yan

records.explanation: 周 is the surname abbreviation for 周伯仁, who responds in dialogue. Coreferent with the full name mention.
records.referent_role: Zhou Boren (周伯仁)

records.explanation: 庾元規 is the full name of Yu Yuangui, who speaks to 周伯仁. Coreferent with 庾 (surname reference).
records.referent_role: Yu Yuangui (庾元規), the speaker

records.explanation: 吳王 is the ruler of Wu to whom 西施 was presented (獻之吳王). Distinct from 齊宣王 and 西施.
records.referent_role: ruler of Wu (吳王)

records.explanation: 庾 is the surname abbreviation for 庾元規, who responds in dialogue. Coreferent with the full name mention.
records.referent_role: Yu Yuangui (庾元規)

records.explanation: 王 in the annotation '王拜為正后' refers to the king who appointed the woman as his principal consort. Given the context of 齊宣王 in the same annotation, this 王 refers to 齊宣王.
records.referent_role: 齊宣王 (King Xuan of Qi)

records.explanation: 無鹽 refers to the famously ugly woman from 無鹽 (鍾離春), used in the comparison '刻畫無鹽以唐突西子' (carving/painting 無鹽 to affront 西子). The Liu annotation (sfh1-ev-26-qingdi-002-liu-annotation-002/003) describes 鍾離春 as the ugly woman of 無鹽. This is a descriptive reference to that historical figure, distinct from 西子.
records.referent_role: person used in comparison (ugly woman)

records.explanation: 中山人 is a descriptive reference identifying 樂毅 as a person from Zhongshan. The annotation '樂毅中山人賢而為燕' directly links 中山人 to 樂毅.
records.referent_role: 樂毅, described as a person from Zhongshan

records.referent_role: The feudal lords (collective)

records.explanation: 諸人 refers to a collective group of people who compare 周伯仁 to 樂. This is a collective descriptive reference, distinct from the individuals named in the text.
records.referent_role: the group of people (諸人) who compare 周伯仁 to 樂

records.explanation: 西施 is the full name of Xishi, the beauty. She is coreferent with 西子 in the main text (西子 refers to Xishi). She was presented to 吳王.
records.referent_role: Xishi, the beauty from Yue

records.explanation: 昭王 is a ruler title referring to King Zhao of Yan. He is the one who commands the general (將軍) to lead the feudal lords against Qi.
records.referent_role: 昭王 (King Zhao of Yan)

西子 is a nickname/abbreviated reference for 西施 (Xi Shi), the famous beauty. The Liu annotation (sfh1-ev-26-qingdi-002-liu-annotation-005) identifies 西施 as the person named 西施, and 西子 is the same person referred to by a shortened/nickname form. 親 here is part of the compound 君親 (ruler and parents), referring to one's parents/kin as the other difficult obligation. It is distinct from 君 (ruler). The compound 君親 is discussed in the main text where 許玄度 says 舉君親以為難. This is also referenced in the Liu annotation where 父子一本也亦不復難君親 connects the concept of father-son unity to the 君親 difficulty.
records.referent_role: parents (親) in the compound 君親

records.explanation: 諸人 refers to the various people who gave differing answers (或父或君) in the discussion about whether to save the ruler or the father.

records.explanation: 許玄度 is the full name of Xu Xuandu, the person Jianwen converses with. He is distinct from Jianwen.

records.explanation: 許 in the Liu annotation is a surname reference to Xu Xuandu (許玄度), the same person as in the main text. The annotation discusses Jianwen's criticism of Xu.

records.explanation: 簡文 in the main text is a ruler title reference to Emperor Jianwen. He converses with Xu Xuandu (許玄度).

records.explanation: 邴原 is the full name of the person. The annotation '傳魏五官' refers to his biography, and he is the holder of the 魏五官 office. He is also referred to as 原 and 中郎將 later in the annotation.
records.referent_role: person named

records.explanation: 君親 is a compositional kinship reference meaning 'ruler and parents', referring to the two categories of authority figures. The annotation compares 父子 with 君親, arguing they are fundamentally the same (一本).
records.referent_role: referent

records.explanation: 魏五官 is an office title (魏's 五官中郎將). The annotation '傳魏五官' refers to the biography of 邴原 who held this office. The office title refers to 邴原 as the holder.
records.referent_role: office holder

records.explanation: 玄度 is the courtesy name of Xu Xuandu, referring to the same person. After Xu leaves, Jianwen remarks about 玄度 (Xu).
records.referent_role: referent

records.explanation: 父子 is a compositional kinship reference meaning 'father and son', referring to the collective of father and child as one unit. The annotation contrasts 父子 (father-son) with 君親 (ruler and parents), arguing they are fundamentally the same.
records.referent_role: referent

records.explanation: 羣賢 refers to a group of worthy scholars. 原 (邴原) discussed with them (甞與羣賢共論), so they are co-present but distinct from 原.
records.referent_role: group of worthy people

records.explanation: 父 refers to father, contrasted with 君 (ruler) in the question 君邪與父邪. These are distinct referents being compared.
records.referent_role: father

records.explanation: 簡文 in the Liu annotation refers to the same ruler (Emperor Jianwen) as in the main text. It is a ruler title reference. The annotation mentions 簡文誚許意, indicating Jianwen criticizing Xu.
records.referent_role: referent

records.explanation: 君 here is part of the compound 君親 (ruler and parents), referring to the ruler as one of the two difficult obligations mentioned by 許玄度. It refers to the ruler (簡文 as the sovereign), and is distinct from 親 (parents). The compound 君親 is discussed in the main text where 許玄度 says 舉君親以為難.
records.referent_role: ruler (君) in the compound 君親

records.explanation: 原 is the abbreviated personal name of 邴原, who is also referred to as 魏五官 and 中郎將 in the annotation.
records.referent_role: person named

records.explanation: 中郎將 is the office title held by 邴原 (原). The text says 原/中郎將甞與羣賢共論, indicating 原 is the 中郎將.
records.referent_role: office holder

records.explanation: 君 here refers to the ruler/sovereign (君父俱病 context), contrasted with 父 (father). In the context of 君父俱病與君邪與父邪, 君 and 父 are distinct referents being compared.
records.referent_role: ruler/sovereign

records.explanation: 士卒 is a descriptive collective reference to the soldiers under 魏武's command. They receive the command (令) from 魏武, and are distinct from him as the commanded party.
records.referent_role: collective of soldiers/subordinates

records.explanation: 魏武 refers to Cao Cao (魏武帝), a ruler/commander figure. He issues a command (乃令曰) to the soldiers (士卒), establishing a commander-subordinate social relation. He is clearly distinct from the soldiers.
records.referent_role: ruler/commander

records.explanation: 帝 in the Liu annotation refers to the emperor (晉明帝), coreferent with the other 帝 mentions and 晉明帝 in the main text. Distinct from 敦 (王敦) and 悟.

records.explanation: 帝 refers to 晉明帝 (Emperor Ming of Jin). The annotation states 帝所生母荀氏燕, meaning the Emperor's birth mother was Xun of Yan. This is the same emperor referenced throughout the main text and annotation.

records.explanation: 敦 is the abbreviated personal name for 王敦 (Wang Dun), coreferent with 王大將軍 and 王敦 in the main text. Distinct from the emperor and 悟.

荀氏 is a surname reference to the emperor's birth mother, a woman of the Xun clan from Yan. The annotation explicitly states 帝所生母荀氏燕, identifying her as the emperor's biological mother.

黄須鮮卑奴 is Wang Dun's derogatory description of the emperor (晉明帝). The Liu annotation explains that the emperor's mother was a Xianbei woman (荀氏燕), which is why he looked like a Xianbei. This descriptive reference corefers with 晉明帝 and 帝. It is distinct from Wang Dun and the old woman.
records.referent_role: the emperor (晉明帝), described by Wang Dun as a yellow-bearded Xianbei slave

records.explanation: 敦 is the abbreviated single-character form of 王敦. It corefers with 王敦 (sfh1-mention-aebc7871226781688d728474) and 王大將軍 (sfh1-mention-011791e88e6bb1da81bdcc21). Wang Dun speaks, identifying the emperor as the 黄須鮮卑奴.

騎 refers to the riders/horsemen who pursue the emperor. They are sent by 王敦 (the 大將軍) and are distinct from the emperor, the old woman, and the 黄須鮮卑奴 description of the emperor. They are coreferent with 追士 later in the text.
records.referent_role: The riders/horsemen sent by 王敦 to pursue the emperor

records.explanation: 悟 is the speaker in the Liu annotation, remarking about the emperor (帝) and 敦. It is a direct person form referring to the annotator/commentator figure, distinct from both 帝 and 敦.

records.explanation: 太后 (Empress Dowager) presides over court (臨朝) while the young emperor is in swaddling. She is a ruler figure in her own right during this regency period.

records.explanation: 成帝 is the emperor (ruler) in swaddling clothes. The annotation states 成帝在繦褓 and 太后臨朝, indicating the emperor is a child with the empress dowager presiding over court.
records.referent_role: 成帝 (Emperor Cheng), the young emperor in swaddling clothes

records.explanation: 温嶠 is the subject who sends a 叅軍 (staff officer) and pushes 陶侃 as盟主. He is distinct from 庾亮 and 陶侃. The later mention 嶠 (sfh1-mention-c4ca2dc6b131f7f10bfe9b66) refers to the same person.
records.referent_role: 温嶠, a Jin official who sent a 叅軍 to push 陶侃 as盟主

records.explanation: 晁錯 (Chao Cuo) is a full-name reference to the Han dynasty figure, cited in the annotation as a comparison for Su Jun's situation. He is distinct from all other persons in the passage.
