叅軍 is an office title referring to a staff officer under 温嶠's command. It is a collective/office reference, not a specific named individual. The patron is 温嶠 who dispatched this officer.
records.referent_role: a staff officer (叅軍) sent by 温嶠

records.explanation: 王愆期 is a full name reference to a person who, along with 温嶠, pushed 陶侃 to be盟主. He is distinct from 陶侃 and 亮.
records.referent_role: person mentioned as pushing 陶侃 to be盟主

records.explanation: No valid semantic record was returned; fail closed.
陶侃 is the full name of 陶公 (the honorific in the main text). He holds the office of 征西 and is pushed to be盟主. He is distinct from 王愆期 and 亮.
records.referent_role: 征西 (General who Conquers the West) and盟主

records.explanation: No valid semantic record was returned; fail closed.

蘇峻 is a full-name reference to the rebel general Su Jun, mentioned in the Liu annotation. He is compared to 晁錯 (Chao Cuo) in the annotation text. He is distinct from the other named persons in the same annotation passage.
records.referent_role: historical figure referenced in comparison

records.explanation: 我 is the first-person pronoun used by 温公 (温嶠) in his speech to 庾亮. 温公 says 我為卿保之 — 'I will guarantee it for you.' The speaker is 温嶠, who is 温公.
records.referent_role: speaker

records.explanation: 亮 is a surname-only reference to 庾亮, who suffered defeat (敗績) at the time when 陶侃 was being pushed as盟主. Corefers with other 庾亮 mentions.
records.referent_role: 庾亮, who suffered defeat (敗績)

records.explanation: No valid semantic record was returned; fail closed.
No valid semantic record was returned; fail closed.
陶士衡 is the courtesy name of 陶侃. In the speech 庾元規何縁拜陶士衡, 陶侃 refers to himself by his own courtesy name. This is the same person as 陶公 in the main text and 陶侃 in the annotations.
records.referent_role: person being addressed/referred to

records.explanation: 嶠 is the personal name of 温嶠, referring back to the earlier full-name mention. The context '嶠愈相崇重分兵以配給之' shows 温嶠 treating 庾亮 with respect and giving him troops.
records.referent_role: 温嶠, referred to by personal name 嶠

records.explanation: No valid semantic record was returned; fail closed.
庾元規 is the courtesy name of 庾亮. 陶侃 addresses him by this courtesy name in the speech 庾元規何縁拜陶士衡. This is the same person as 庾公, 庾, and 卿 in the main text, and 庾亮 in the annotations.
records.referent_role: person being addressed/referred to

records.explanation: 王導 (Wang Dao) is a full-name reference to the Eastern Jin statesman, mentioned alongside 卞壷 as both advising against summoning Su Jun. He is distinct from the other named persons in the passage.
records.referent_role: historical figure mentioned as advisor

records.explanation: 陶公 is an honorific reference to 陶侃, coreferring with the full name 陶侃 in the annotation. He is distinct from 庾公 (庾亮) and 温公 (温嶠).
records.referent_role: 陶侃, addressed with honorific 公

records.explanation: 庾亮 is identified as 元舅 (chief maternal uncle) assisting in governance while 成帝 is in swaddling and 太后 presides over court. This is an office-holder reference with the office being 輔政 (assisting governance).
records.referent_role: 庾亮, serving as 元舅 (chief maternal uncle) assisting in governance

records.explanation: 王隱 is the full name of the Jin dynasty historian who authored the 王隱晉書. The annotation 003 begins '王隱晉書曰' — attributing the following text to 王隱's work. This is a direct reference to the historian 王隱, distinct from all other persons in the passage.
records.referent_role: 王隱 (the historian, author of 王隱晉書)

records.explanation: 女 here is the second occurrence referring to the same daughter introduced as 一女. It is an anaphoric reference to the daughter of 劉氏. The text 女以手披紗扇 shows this is the bride who marries 嶠.
records.referent_role: the daughter of 劉氏 (the aunt), same as 一女

records.explanation: 髙平李暅 is the father of 嶠's first wife per the annotation '嶠𥘉取髙平李暅女'. The annotation lists 嶠's successive marriages: first to 髙平李暅's daughter, then to 廬江何䆳's daughter, then to 琅邪王詡's daughter. 髙平李暅 is distinct from the other fathers-in-law mentioned.
records.referent_role: person named 髙平李暅, first wife of 嶠 (温嶠)

records.explanation: The annotation '谷口云劉氏政謂其姑' clarifies that 劉氏 refers to the paternal aunt (姑) of 嶠, not to a wife surnamed 劉. This 劉氏 is the same person as the 姑 in the main text and in annotation-002. She is distinct from the daughter (女) who is the bride.
records.referent_role: the woman surnamed 劉, i.e., 温嶠's paternal aunt (姑)

records.explanation: 孝標 is the courtesy name of Liu Xiaobiao, the annotator. The annotation text '孝標之注亦未為得' refers to Liu Xiaobiao's annotation being criticized. 谷口 is a different person who offers a correction, so they are distinct.
records.referent_role: courtesy name of 劉孝標 (Liu Xiaobiao), the annotator

records.explanation: 劉聦 is the ruler of the 屠各 people (匈奴), the target of the northern campaign. He is distinct from 劉越石. The annotation identifies 聦 as 劉聦 (same person), and notes 琨 (劉琨) campaigned against him. The annotation also identifies 聦 as 載, courtesy name 玄明, son of 淵.
records.referent_role: ruler/enemy leader (劉聦, ruler of the 屠各/匈奴)

records.explanation: 琨 is Liu Kun, who is described as 假守左司馬都督上前鋒諸軍事 and is the subject who 討 (attacks) 劉聦. He is distinct from 劉聦 whom he attacks.
records.referent_role: Liu Kun (琨), who held the office of 假守左司馬都督上前鋒諸軍事

records.explanation: 聦 is the abbreviated form of 劉聦 (Liu Cong), the Xiongnu ruler. The annotation states 聦一名載字玄明, so 聦, 載, and 玄明 all refer to the same person. His father is 淵 (Liu Yuan). The annotation also mentions 劉聦 as the target of 琨's military campaign.
records.referent_role: ruler/leader of the Xiongnu (Liu Cong)

records.explanation: 廬江何䆳 is a full name in the Liu annotation. The annotation indicates that 嶠 later took the daughter of 廬江何䆳, making 廬江何䆳 the father of a later wife of 嶠.
records.referent_role: person named 廬江何䆳, father of a woman later married to 嶠

records.explanation: 一女 refers to the single daughter of 劉氏 (the aunt). The text says 姑以屬公覓㛰 — the aunt entrusted her daughter to 温公 to find a marriage. This daughter later marries 嶠 (温公). The daughter is distinct from the aunt and from 嶠.
records.referent_role: the daughter of 劉氏 (the aunt)

records.explanation: 嶠 is the personal name of 温嶠. In annotation 003, the text reads '嶠為劉...' indicating 嶠 served under 劉 (劉琨). This 嶠 corefers with the other 嶠 mentions (in annotation 001 and main text). The annotation 002 context establishes that the 姑 is 嶠's aunt.
records.referent_role: 温嶠 (the person 嶠)

records.explanation: 姑 here refers to 温嶠's paternal aunt (從姑), the aunt of his wife. The text says 温公䘮婦從姑劉氏, meaning Wen Gong's wife's paternal aunt, surnamed Liu. This 姑 is the same person as 劉氏 (mention cfce79a74e25089e5e4e6fe8) in the main text. The annotation 002 confirms that 劉氏 refers to the 姑 (谷口云劉氏政謂其姑).
records.referent_role: 温嶠's paternal aunt (從姑), the wife's aunt

records.explanation: 琅邪王詡 is a full name in the Liu annotation, identified as the father of a woman (女) who was later taken by 嶠. The kinship relation is explicit in the annotation text.
records.referent_role: person named 琅邪王詡, father of a woman who later married 嶠

records.explanation: 劉聦 is Liu Cong, coreferent with 聦 (sfh1-mention-3df10759e8c0e7cd8658ec4e) mentioned earlier in the same annotation. He is the son of 淵 and the target of 琨's attack. He is distinct from 琨 and from 淵 and 淵's father.
records.referent_role: Liu Cong (劉聦), the target of Liu Kun's attack

records.explanation: 玄明 is the courtesy name (字) of 聦/載 as stated in the annotation: 聦一名載字玄明. All three forms refer to Liu Cong.
records.referent_role: ruler/leader of the Xiongnu (Liu Cong), courtesy name

records.explanation: 淵 is Liu Yuan, the father of 聦 (Liu Cong). The text 父淵因亂起兵死聦嗣 indicates 淵 is the father who died and 聦 succeeded him. 淵 is distinct from his father (父) and from 聦.
records.referent_role: Liu Yuan (淵), father of 聦, ancestor of 劉聦

records.explanation: The mention 父 refers to the father of 淵 (Liu Yuan). The text reads 父淵, meaning 'father Yuan', establishing a kinship relation where 父 is the father of 淵.
records.referent_role: father of 淵 (Liu Yuan)

records.explanation: 劉越石 is the person for whom 温公 (嶠) served as 長史. The text states '公為劉越石長史北征劉聦所得'. 劉越石 is the office patron/employer, distinct from 劉聦 who is the enemy being campaigned against.
records.referent_role: office holder (長史 under 温公/嶠)

records.explanation: The mention 業 appears in annotation 005 which is a fragment (業) with no surrounding context in the provided evidence. It is a personal name but its referent cannot be determined from the available context.
records.referent_role: person referred to by personal name 業

records.explanation: No valid semantic record was returned; fail closed.
No valid semantic record was returned; fail closed.
屠各人 is a descriptive ethnic reference describing Liu Cong (聦) as a person of the Tuge (Xiongnu) people. It describes the same individual as 聦/載/玄明, identifying his ethnic origin.
records.referent_role: ethnic/group descriptor for Liu Cong (Xiongnu/Tuge people)

records.explanation: 嶠 is the personal name of 温嶠, the protagonist of the story. In the Liu annotation, it states 嶠初取髙平李暅女中取琅邪王詡女後取廬江何䆳女, showing 嶠 married three women in sequence. This 嶠 in the annotation refers to the same person as 温公/嶠 in the main text.
records.referent_role: 嶠 (温嶠), the person who married the daughters of 琅邪王詡 and 廬江何䆳

records.explanation: In the annotation, 谷口 states '劉氏政謂其姑' — the 劉氏 refers to the 姑 (paternal aunt). The mention 姑 here is the aunt of 嶠 (温嶠). The annotation explicitly identifies 劉氏 as referring to the 姑, so this 姑 corefers with the 劉氏 mentions. The annotation also notes that 孝標's interpretation (that 劉氏 refers to the daughter's surname) is incorrect.
records.referent_role: paternal aunt (姑) of 嶠 (温嶠)

records.explanation: 劉氏 in the main text refers to the paternal aunt (姑) of 温嶠's wife, surnamed Liu. The annotation 002 explicitly states 谷口云劉氏政謂其姑, confirming that 劉氏 refers to the 姑. This is the same person as mention 63d4d19b4fa744332ded8025 (姑).
records.referent_role: the paternal aunt surnamed Liu (劉氏)

records.explanation: In annotation 003, the text reads '嶠為劉...' — 嶠 served under 劉. Given the main text mentions 温公為劉越石長史 (温嶠 was 劉越石's 長史), and 劉越石 is 劉琨, this 劉 in annotation 003 likely refers to 劉琨. The annotation 004 mentions 琨 (劉琨) as well. This is a surname-only reference to 劉琨.
records.referent_role: 劉琨 (surname-only reference)

records.explanation: 谷口 is a commentator who provides a correction to 孝標's annotation, stating that 劉氏 refers to the aunt (姑). 谷口 is distinct from 孝標 since the text presents 谷口 as offering a different interpretation from 孝標.
records.referent_role: person named 谷口, a commentator who corrects Liu Xiaobiao's annotation

records.explanation: 温公 is the office-title reference to 温嶠 (Wen Qiao). The main text describes him as having lost his wife and having a paternal aunt (從姑) surnamed 劉. The name 嶠 appears later in the text (mention b111c0c535e68cbda0013acd) referring to the same person. The 姑 (paternal aunt) is distinct from 温公.
records.referent_role: 温嶠 (Wen Qiao), referred to by his office title 温公

records.explanation: 載 is stated as an alternate name (一名) for 聦 in the annotation: 聦一名載字玄明. Thus 載, 聦, and 玄明 all refer to the same person, Liu Cong.
records.referent_role: ruler/leader of the Xiongnu (Liu Cong), alternate name

records.explanation: 女 is a kinship reference meaning daughter of 琅邪王詡. The annotation states 琅邪王詡女後取廬江何䆳女, meaning the daughter of 琅邪王詡 was later taken (married) by 嶠, and then 嶠 took the daughter of 廬江何䆳.
records.referent_role: daughter of 琅邪王詡, later married to 嶠

records.explanation: 王文度 is Wang Wéndù (王述's son, also known as 王坦之). In the main text, 阿智 is described as his 弟 (younger brother). The kinship relation is brother-brother. 王文度 corefers with 文度 in the main text.
records.referent_role: person named

records.explanation: 文將 is the courtesy name (字) of 王䖍之, as stated in the annotation '䖍之字文將'. It corefers with the same person.
records.referent_role: person named

records.explanation: 王䖍之 is the full name. The annotation states 阿智 is his 小字, and 文將 is his 字 (courtesy name).
records.referent_role: person named

阿智 is the nickname (小字) of 王䖍之, as stated in the annotation '阿智王䖍之小字'. It corefers with 王䖍之, 䖍之, and 文將.
records.referent_role: nickname of 王䖍之

records.explanation: 太原孫綽 is a full name with place of origin (太原) and personal name (孫綽). This is Sun Chuo, the father of 阿恒 (孫綽女).
records.referent_role: person named

records.explanation: 藍田 is an office title referring to 王述 (Wang Shù), who held the title 藍田侯. He is the father of 王文度 and 阿智. 文度 reports to him ('啓藍田'), and he is distinct from 興公 (孫綽).
records.referent_role: 王述 (Wang Shù), father of 王文度 and 阿智, holder of the office 藍田 (藍田侯)

别駕 is an office title in the Liu annotation. It refers to the person who held the office of 别駕 (assistant to the governor). The annotation context suggests this refers to 王䖍之 who declined the office (不就).
records.referent_role: office holder

records.explanation: 阿恒 is the nickname of 孫綽's daughter, as stated in the annotation '太原孫綽女字阿恒'. The kinship relation is father-daughter.
records.referent_role: daughter of 孫綽

records.explanation: 文度 is the personal name (given name) of 王文度 (Wang Wéndù). The full name 王文度 appears at the start of the main text. 文度 is the abbreviated form of that full name. 文度 is the elder brother of 阿智 (王䖍之), and the son of 藍田 (王述).
records.referent_role: 王述 (Wang Wéndù's father, also known as 藍田)

records.explanation: 䖍之 is the personal name portion of 王䖍之, an abbreviated reference to the same person.
records.referent_role: person named

君 is a second-person honorific pronoun used by 王武子 (Wang Wuzi) when addressing 和嶠 (He Qiao). The context is 王武子 asking '何如君李' (how about your plums), where 君 refers to the addressee 和嶠. The mention 和公 (sfh1-mention-0e78ebb30f7ea9bfd3a446d0) earlier in the same sentence refers to the same person 和嶠, and 和嶠 (sfh1-mention-0d2a2d14256e0cfeb7ea704a) is the full name. 君 is distinct from 王武子 who is the speaker. The speech relation is anchored in the main text where 王武子 asks about 君's plums.
records.referent_role: addressee

陶公 is an honorific reference to 陶侃. He is the one who asks 庾 what the white scallion roots are for. Distinct from 庾太尉/庾.
records.referent_role: 陶侃 (Tao Kan)

陶 is a surname-only reference to 陶侃, coreferring with 陶公. He is the one who highly appreciated 庾亮. Distinct from 庾太尉/庾.
records.referent_role: 陶侃 (Tao Kan)

records.explanation: 庾太尉 refers to 庾亮 by his office title (太尉). He is the subject who fled south and met 陶公. He is distinct from 陶公/陶. The later 庾 (surname reference) corefers with him.
records.referent_role: 庾亮 (Yu Liang), Grand Commandant (太尉)

宣王 refers to Sima Yi, the founder of the Jin dynasty enterprise. Wang Dao narrates how Xuan Wang began the enterprise, exterminated prominent families, and favored his own allies. The Liu annotation confirms 宣王創業誅曹爽任蔣濟.
records.referent_role: Xuan Wang (Sima Yi)

records.explanation: 王導 is the full name of Wang Dao, who appears together with 温嶠 before 明帝. He is coreferent with the surname reference 王 and the pronoun 臣.
records.referent_role: 王導, court official

records.explanation: 陛下 is the honorific form of address used by Wang Dao to refer to the emperor (Ming Di).
records.referent_role: emperor (Ming Di)

records.explanation: 曹爽 is a full name reference to the historical figure Cao Shuang, who was executed by 宣王 (Sima Yi).
records.referent_role: 曹爽, historical figure

records.explanation: 蔣濟 is a full name reference to Jiang Ji, a figure employed by 宣王 (Sima Yi) in the events described.
records.referent_role: 蔣濟, historical figure

records.explanation: 温嶠年少未諳 is a descriptive reference to Wen Qiao, describing him as young and inexperienced. Wang Dao says this about Wen Qiao to the emperor.
records.referent_role: young official being described

records.explanation: 温 is the surname abbreviation for 温嶠, coreferent with the full name 温嶠 and the descriptive reference 温嶠年少未諳.
records.referent_role: 温嶠, court official

records.explanation: 王 is the surname abbreviation for 王導, who speaks to the emperor. It is coreferent with the full name 王導 and the pronoun 臣.
records.referent_role: 王導, court official

records.explanation: No valid semantic record was returned; fail closed.
帝 is a local anaphoric reference to 明帝 mentioned immediately before. The emperor asks Wang Dao and Wen Qiao about how the previous dynasty gained the throne.
records.referent_role: ruler

records.explanation: No valid semantic record was returned; fail closed.
明帝 is the ruler title for Emperor Ming of Jin. Coreferent with 帝 and the honorific 陛下. He questions 王導 and 温嶠 about how the previous dynasty gained the throne.
records.referent_role: 明帝, emperor of Jin

records.explanation: 臣 is Wang Dao referring to himself humbly before the emperor. He says 'I will explain it for Your Majesty.'
records.referent_role: speaker (Wang Dao)

records.explanation: 宣王 in the Liu annotation refers to Sima Yi, the founder of the Jin dynasty. He is distinct from 曹爽 and 蔣濟, whom he acted against/with in the events described.
records.referent_role: 宣王 (Sima Yi), ruler/ancestor figure

records.explanation: 温嶠 is the full name of Wen Qiao, who appears together with 王導 before 明帝. Coreferent with the surname 温 and the descriptive reference 温嶠年少未諳.
records.referent_role: 温嶠, court official

records.explanation: 陽公主 is the princess title; the annotation states she is 武帝's daughter (武帝女) and that 敦 married her (敦尚武帝女).
records.referent_role: princess (daughter of emperor, married to Wang Dun)

records.explanation: 王 is the surname-only reference to Wang Dun, coreferent with the full name 王敦.
records.referent_role: Wang Dun (surname-only reference)

羣婢 is a descriptive collective reference to the group of maidservants. It corefers with the earlier 婢 mention (sfh1-mention-0a59c038825186484bbce52d) in the same text, both referring to the same group of serving women. They are distinct from 王敦 (sfh1-mention-c85cc0ec826997e0bd30fb6c), who is the subject of their laughter. The relation is co-presence: the maidservants laugh at Wang Dun's behavior.
records.referent_role: collective group of maidservants

records.explanation: 女 in the annotation 武帝女 refers to the daughter of Emperor Wu, which is the same person as 陽公主.
records.referent_role: daughter of Emperor Wu (i.e., the princess)

records.explanation: 修褘 is the courtesy name (字) of 陽公主, given in the annotation as her personal name.
records.referent_role: personal name (字) of the princess

records.explanation: 武帝 is Emperor Wu, the father of the princess as stated in the annotation (武帝女).
records.referent_role: Emperor Wu (武帝) of Jin, father of the princess

records.explanation: 王敦 is the full name of the protagonist; he married the princess (尚主).
records.referent_role: Wang Dun, the protagonist of the story

records.explanation: 敦 is the abbreviated form of 王敦, referring to the same person as the full name in the main text.
records.referent_role: Wang Dun (short form of 王敦)

驃騎 is an office title. The annotation '師至驃騎咨議' indicates that 殷師 (師) held the office of 驃騎咨議. The office holder is 殷師.
records.referent_role: office title 驃騎 (General of Cavalry), held by 殷師

records.explanation: 殷公 is an honorific reference to the person surnamed 殷 (the father of 殷仲堪). 孝武 asks whether there is an 殷 (person) with such an illness. This refers to 殷仲堪's father, coreferring with 父 in the main text and 仲堪父 in the annotation.
records.referent_role: honorific 殷公 referring to 殷仲堪's father

records.explanation: 仲堪父 is a compositional kinship reference meaning 'father of 仲堪'. This refers to 殷師, the same person named in the 殷氏譜 annotation. The kinship relation is explicit in the surface form.
records.referent_role: father of 仲堪 (殷仲堪)

records.explanation: 融 is the personal name of the father of 祖識, coreferring with the kinship reference 父融. The annotation '子祖識父融並有名' shows 融 is distinct from 祖識.
records.referent_role: 融, father of 祖識

records.explanation: 仲堪 in the annotation is the personal name of 殷仲堪, coreferring with the full name in the main text. He is the son of 殷師 (仲堪父).
records.referent_role: 殷仲堪

records.explanation: 臣 is the first-person pronoun used by 殷仲堪 when addressing the emperor (孝武). It is a local anaphoric reference coreferring with 殷仲堪 and 仲堪.
records.referent_role: first-person pronoun 臣 used by 殷仲堪 addressing the emperor

records.explanation: 殷師 is the full name of 殷仲堪's father, as stated in the 殷氏譜 annotation. The courtesy name 師 (sfh1-mention-f6e97d25214ec3e470f9ba53) refers to the same person. The annotation '生仲堪' establishes the father-son kinship.
records.referent_role: person named 殷師, father of 殷仲堪

records.explanation: 咨議 is an office title. The annotation states 師至驃騎咨議, meaning 殷師 (師) held the office of 咨議. The office title refers to the position, and the holder is 殷師.
records.referent_role: office title 咨議 (advisor/consultant) held by 殷師

records.explanation: 常人 refers to ordinary/common people as a collective. The text states 粲簡貴不與常人交接 (Xun Can was aloof and did not associate with ordinary people). This is a collective reference distinct from 粲 himself and from the 名士 group of famous scholars.
